name: Nyari
source:
Chatterbox and gossip extraordinaire, Nuari is one of SSL's most popular operators. Always full of energy and ready to help those who need her, Nyari loves her job and life in general.

Despite her sunny nature, Nyari can also be somewhat  two-faced and quick to criticise those who object to her way of doing things.
